items.einen: einen is an object form. The subject here is man.

items.niemand: niemand is for people. For things: nichts.

items.Jedes: jedes needs a singular neuter noun. Kinder is plural.
items.Jede: jede needs a singular feminine noun.

items.Alle: alle would need the plural verb sind.

items.man: man has only the Nominativ. Other cases use einem or einen.
items.einen: einen is the Akkusativ. passieren takes the Dativ: einem.

items.niemanden: niemanden is the Akkusativ. erzählen takes the Dativ for the person.

items.kaltes: After etwas the adjective is written with a capital letter: Kaltes.
items.Kalt: After etwas the adjective needs the ending -es: Kaltes.

items.Guten: The fixed phrase is Alles Gute.
items.Gutes: The fixed phrase is Alles Gute.

items.das: After alles the relative word is was.
items.dass: dass is a conjunction, not a relative word.

items.jedes: jedes is the Nominativ or Akkusativ. schenken takes the Dativ: jedem.
items.jeden: jeden is masculine Akkusativ. Kind is neuter and in the Dativ: jedem.

items.Mancher: Mancher is masculine singular. Leute is plural.

items.wenig: wenig is for things you cannot count.

items.Ja: Ja would agree with the negative question.
items.Nein: Nein would confirm it: no, I am not coming.

items.irgendeine: irgendeine is singular feminine. Fragen is plural.

items.mal: mal softens a request. It does not make a guess.
mal softens a request. The shade here is ja.

items.halt: halt means „that is just how it is“.

items.alle: alle would take the plural verb haben. jeder von uns is singular: hat.
items.alles: alles is for things, not people.
